email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with high fever and confusion
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 49-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their third dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 5mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-07-07.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed high fever and confusion.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter759@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
